_comment: Dessert Person's specific short ALL-CAPS labels used WITHIN a recipe, as opposed to a new recipe or section title. These are component section headers (CAKE, GLAZE, FILLING, FROSTING, etc.) and recipe-internal asides that appear between ingredient groups or in the body of a recipe. Used by ingest.py to avoid incorrectly splitting a recipe apart at one of these. The semantic role here is different from The Book On Pie (where the same whitelist covered batch-size alternatives like HALF BATCH), but the mechanical purpose is identical: keep these attached to their parent recipe chunk rather than treating them as a new chunk boundary. This is book-specific: a different cookbook may use different labels, or none at all; a missing file for a book just means it has no special case here. Add new entries as you spot ALL-CAPS labels inside recipes that are incorrectly splitting chunks during ingest.
